verdict.rationale: Unleash documents change requests that require an additional approval step before any change can be made in an environment, such as production. Changes can also be grouped and applied at a set time. The GitHub README lists change requests among its hosted/enterprise features, and the docs describe environments that keep production configuration separate. Missing for 10: detail on configuring approvers and approval counts per environment, independent or hands-on corroboration, and clarity on which tiers include the feature.
